description.value: Neptune Chinese Kitchen is a Chinese restaurant located on the UBC Vancouver campus offering both western-style and traditional Chinese dishes. The menu is notably broad, spanning dim sum, congee, BBQ meats, hot pot, fried noodles, and a large tofu/vegetable selection. Situated near Saveonfood on Shrum Lane, it makes a convenient full-meal stop for cyclists exploring the UBC peninsula.
